**PotentialPunch 1.0.1**: bug fix.

- **Fixed:** the MPC's **PRESET** menu kept closing (and its list flickered) while PotentialPunch was open. The live meter no longer makes the MPC redraw its screen, so the menu stays open.
- The line above the meter is now a short tip instead of live numbers; the meter still shows the boost or cut as it happens.

Saved projects keep working. **Download** `PotentialPunch-1.0.1-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
